name: jkamsker-skills
description: Agent Skills by Jonas Kamsker: CLI design, Roslyn source generator, and Gitea/Forgejo forge tooling expertise.

plugins.name: build-ergonomic-clis
plugins.description: Design, review, and implement product-grade command-line interfaces: command trees, flag conventions, auth and profile UX, config precedence, human-first output with opt-in --json, and exit codes.

plugins.name: git-forges
plugins.description: Detect and operate Gitea and Forgejo forges: reliable forge detection scripts (Forgejo vs Gitea vs GitHub vs GitLab, sub-path and locked instances included), fj/fj-ex workflows for Forgejo Actions and PRs, and tea plus a REST-backed PowerShell toolkit for Gitea.

plugins.name: incremental-source-generator
plugins.description: Design, review, debug, and fix Roslyn incremental source generators: pipeline incrementality, equatable models, marker attributes, MSBuild inputs, snapshot tests, and analyzer packaging.
